[Verse 1]
[D5]I feel so unsure
[Gm]As I
[Bb]take your hand and lead you
[A7]to the dance floor
[D5]As the music dies,
[Gm]something in your eyes
[Bb]Calls to mind a silver screen and
[A7]all it's sad goodbyes

[Chorus]
[D5]I'm never gonna dance again These
[Gm]guilty feet have got no rhythm
[Bb]Though it's easy to pretend I
[A7]know you're not a fool I
[D5]should have known better than to cheat a friend And
[Gm]waste a chance that I've been given
[Bb]So I'm never gonna dance again The
[A7]way I danced with you

[Interlude]
[D5]
[Gm]
[Bb]
[A7]

[Verse 2]
[D5]Time can never mend
[Gm]The
[Bb]careless whispers
[A7]of a good friend
[D5]To the heart and mind,
[Gm]ignorance is kind
[Bb]There's no comfort in the truth,
[A7]pain is all you'll find

[Chorus]
[D5]I'm never gonna dance again These
[Gm]guilty feet have got no rhythm
[Bb]Though it's easy to pretend I

[Gm]waste a chance that I've been given
[Bb]So I'm never gonna dance again The
[A7]way I danced with you

[Interlude]
[D5]
[Gm]
[Bb]
[A7]To-

[Bridge]
[D5]night the music seems so loud I
[Gm]wish that we could lose this crowd
[Bb]Maybe it's better this way We
[A7]hurt each other with the things we wanna say We
[D5]could have been so good together We
[Gm]could have lived this dance forever
[Bb]Now who's gonna dance with me
[A7]Please

[Chorus]
